notes.title: Picture quality options updated!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This update added the image quality selection function, high medium and low three choices, the default is low image quality, you can choose a higher image quality in the settings!

Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Game Updates
notes.notes:
Hello players!

This update removes the limitations of goodwill and allows characters to gain immortality right from the start! This will allow players to experience the game better!


We've noticed a lot of problems after the game's release, and we'll gradually improve and optimize the game, thank you very much for your support and tolerance!

Wish you a happy game!
